top_risks.title: Meta Plans 8,000 Job Cuts
evidence: Meta Platforms Inc. plans to reduce its global workforce by approximately 10%, eliminating nearly 8,000 jobs
top_risks.causal_chain: Job cuts due to company restructuring and AI-driven automation
top_risks.recommended_action: Monitor Meta's job market and adjust workforce strategies accordingly

top_risks.title: China Closes AI Performance Gap
evidence: Stanford’s 2026 AI Index Report finds the performance gap between the best American and Chinese AI models has collapsed to 2.7%
top_risks.causal_chain: Rapid AI advancements in China may render some US skills obsolete
top_risks.recommended_action: Invest in continuous AI-related skills training and education

top_risks.title: Stock Market Highlights: Sensex, Nifty Settle Lower
evidence: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed lower on profit-taking in financial shares
top_risks.causal_chain: Economic uncertainty may lead to hiring slowdown
top_risks.recommended_action: Monitor economic trends and adjust hiring strategies accordingly

top_risks.title: US Government Job Openings
evidence: Job openings for data scientists and machine learning professionals in the US government
top_risks.causal_chain: Government agencies may struggle to transition to AI-driven workforce
top_risks.recommended_action: Develop strategies for public sector workforce transition and upskilling

top_risks.title: Regional Job Market Impacts
evidence: Job openings and layoffs in various regions, including Maryland and Virginia
top_risks.causal_chain: Regional job market may experience shocks due to AI-driven changes
top_risks.recommended_action: Monitor regional job market trends and develop strategies for mitigation

soft_risks.title: AI-Driven Inequality
